tooltip.chunkdestroyer.desc1: Standalone Chunk Destroyer without ScalableCatsForce requirement.
tooltip.chunkdestroyer.desc2: ⚡ Zero Power Required / Full speed out of the box.
tooltip.chunkdestroyer.desc3: 📦 Directly auto-pushes mined drops into adjacent storages.
tooltip.chunkdestroyer.desc4: ⌨ Direct keyboard coordinate input (X, Y, Z) in UI.
tooltip.chunkdestroyer.btn_silk: Toggle between Silk Touch and Fortune III mining mode.
tooltip.chunkdestroyer.btn_liquid: Toggle removing fluids (water & lava) in the mining area.
tooltip.chunkdestroyer.btn_apply: Apply the entered coordinate boundaries (or press Enter).
tooltip.chunkdestroyer.btn_reset: Reset mining cursor back to the top to re-mine the area.
